pages.title: Kerr Metric Shard
pages.text: The exact solution for spacetime around a rotating black hole, found by Roy Kerr in 1963. Near it, spacetime itself is dragged around, and inside the ergosphere nothing can stand still. The shard spins slightly in the hand, even when perfectly balanced.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding a Penrose spindle and a micro singularity through the Tensor Calculus Engine with the field equations, I asked for a solution with spin. The answer, an ergosphere and frame dragging, was the Kerr metric.
